description: This file defines an internal interface IVersionStoreGrain, a class VersionStoreGrain, and a data class VersionStoreGrainState related to managing version and compatibility strategies for grains within the Orleans framework. It includes methods for setting and retrieving strategies, and the class interacts with state storage provider for persistence.

classes.name: VersionStoreGrainState
classes.description: Stores dictionaries of compatibility and version selector strategies, along with override strategies, for grains.

classes.name: VersionStoreGrain
classes.description: A grain implementation for managing version and compatibility strategies for grains, with methods to set and get strategies.

methods.name: SetCompatibilityStrategy
methods.description: Sets the compatibility strategy override in the grain's state and persists it.

methods.name: SetSelectorStrategy
methods.description: Sets the version selector strategy override in the grain's state and persists it.

methods.name: SetCompatibilityStrategy
methods.description: Sets a compatibility strategy for a specific grain interface type and persists the change.

methods.name: SetSelectorStrategy
methods.description: Sets a version selector strategy for a specific grain interface type and persists the change.

methods.name: GetCompatibilityStrategies
methods.description: Retrieves the dictionary of compatibility strategies for all interfaces.

methods.name: GetSelectorStrategies
methods.description: Retrieves the dictionary of version selector strategies for all interfaces.

methods.name: GetCompatibilityStrategy
methods.description: Gets the current override compatibility strategy.

methods.name: GetSelectorStrategy
methods.description: Gets the current override version selector strategy.
